description: This file defines a base class for managing a test cluster in Orleans testing environment, along with extension methods for serialization and copying objects within the test cluster context.

classes.name: HostedTestClusterEnsureDefaultStarted
classes.description: Abstract base class that manages starting a default Orleans silo cluster for testing, providing access to cluster components.

methods.name: RoundTripSystemTextJsonSerialization
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes an object using System.Text.Json to test round-trip serialization.

methods.name: RoundTripSerializationForTesting
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes an object using Orleans Serializer to test serialization integrity.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object within the test cluster context using the DeepCopier service.

methods.name: GetSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves the Serializer instance from the test cluster's service provider.
